we provide a web-based tool for identifying optimal clusters of terms from different ontological sources, which can be applied for the analysis of coexpressed gene groups.
the use of conceptual clusters in GO can be a valuable alternative to traditional approaches that use single GO terms, as well as an independent validation method of gene grouping hypotheses.
